page.overview:
What is Guardians of Time?

The Guardians of Time are a group of Great Old Ones created by the BBC in 1966 for Doctor Who.

The Guardians of Time, are a group of Great Old Ones whom are masters of reality. Elemental forces which embody various aspects of the cosmos. It's a pantheon within a pantheon, the upper echelon of the Great Old Ones. Though at the top of their hierarchy, in some matters they defer to the Greater Old Ones.
